sentences.en: Yanni and Skura were both held captive for fourteen days.
sentences.zh: 扬尼和斯库拉都被关押了十四天。

sentences.en: He came to set the captives free, making sinners into saints.
sentences.zh: 他来解救被囚禁的人，让罪人变成圣人。

sentences.en: The captive escaped in the dark of the night.
sentences.zh: 那个俘虏在深夜逃走了。

senses.zh: 被俘虏的，被监禁的；受控制的，受限制的
俘虏，被监禁的人；受控制的人或动物
